finding: Town plots come from a weighted roll with minimums, caps and gates, and a failed placement leaves an open plaza (a fight space); names follow the area of the land. Flaws: a dead guard-tower roll, an unreachable castle arm, a workshop minimum that takes over every roll until one places, and two names drawn for one choice. Spots are 20 hard-coded kinds plus one data entry, and the frequency counts attempts, not spawns.

A floor is an assembled route: a fixed entrance slot, a fixed treasure slot, a room pool that can repeat and drops a type only when it does not fit, and a per-location roll where the monster share scales with connected players (1 in 4 with one player, 1 in 2 with three or four, of the normal half). Region monster tables and a shrine placed opposite the exit. Code is BSD-2-Clause; the level content is not in the box, so only the rule is taken.
